definition: The support of a witness is the finite set of symbols participating in its antecedents and conclusion.
runtime_analogue: num field and canonical schema symbol set
mathematical_role: Defines support size used by the bound lemma.
caveat: Runtime schema support is finite and explicit.

definition: The support size is the cardinality of the witness support set after canonical relabeling.
missing_sublemma: formal equivalence proof for arbitrary math objects
caveat: Soundness outside runtime normal form remains separate.

definition: Support8 means normalized witness support size is at most 8.
caveat: Does not say support>8 is impossible.

definition: Shell index refines support8 witness by antecedent frontier depth.
mathematical_role: Connects support-bound witness to shell/tail package.

definition: Tail descriptor records whether a support8 witness is in checked tail range or first reviewed extension boundary.
runtime_analogue: tail witness normal form and shell16 extension_distance
mathematical_role: Connects support bound to tail bridge.
caveat: Only checked plus first boundary is closed.

definition: Family-chain component records bounded family obstruction pattern inside the support witness.
runtime_analogue: family-chain theorem objects and lower-layer inventory
mathematical_role: Separates family obstruction from support growth.
caveat: 7/7 freshness is provenance closure, not full lift.

definition: A support witness normal form is support size, canonical schema row, shell/tail descriptor, frontier status, family-chain component, and escape class.
mathematical_role: Routes witnesses into support8 handled case or higher-support escape.
caveat: Normal form is a contract, not full theorem.

definition: A support-minimal witness minimizes lexicographic tuple support size, shell index, tail distance, family depth, frontier rank, canonical fingerprint.
caveat: Finite runtime cases are well-founded; general existence remains conditional.

definition: A support growth obstruction is a witness whose support exceeds 8 and cannot currently be reduced without new lemma.
mathematical_role: Names the blocker instead of hiding it.
caveat: This is the main open blocker.

definition: If support size is greater than 8 and no support-reduction or family-chain lift applies, route to higher_support_escape.
mathematical_role: Exact boundary between selected theorem and broader theorem.
caveat: Escape remains open for full general theorem.
